source_check.note: The selected problem is Theorem 1.4 restricted to d>=2, for a positive measure with finite moments through degree 2d and positive-definite moment matrix. Both the d-by-d bilinear determinant and the symmetric (2d+1)-by-(2d+1) linear determinant, exact normalization and infinity-node definitions are retained. The complete author body includes all local kernel, positive-cone, infinity-quadrature, doubled interpolation, real-fibre/Zariski-density and determinant computations. Two original curve illustrations remain figure-only assets with native captions. Generalized more-node problems and numerical examples are unselected context.
